# Synapse 2.0.10

A small release: when Synapse AI finishes building something, it takes you to it.

## Changed

- **Synapse AI takes you to what it built.** Until now a build ended in the conversation, and you had to go and find what it made. Now a new workflow opens its own page, with Run, beside the conversation. An agent built on its own opens Chat with that agent. A change takes you to what it changed, unless you are already there. Every build also leaves a link in the conversation. If you went to another page or closed the panel while it worked, you stay where you are, and the link is there when you want it. A conversation you open again later still has its links. Nothing moves you for a plan that is waiting for your yes, or for a build that fails or is stopped. A page with unsaved changes asks before you leave it.

## Install

**macOS and Linux**

```bash
curl -LsSf https://synapseorch.com/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://synapseorch.com/install.ps1 | iex
```

<details>
<summary>npm, pip or Docker</summary>

```bash
npm install -g synapse-orch-ai && synapse
pip install synapse-orch-ai && synapse         # Python 3.11–3.14 and Node.js 20.9+
```

For Docker, see [Docker](https://docs.synapseorch.com/getting-started/docker): the image is `synapseorchai/synapse-ai:2.0.10`, also `:latest`.
</details>

## Upgrading

- **From 2.0.x:** run `synapse upgrade`. Your data stays where it is, and the database is backed up first.
- **From 1.x:** run `synapse upgrade` on your 1.x install. It moves you to 2.0 the same way 2.0.0 did; read the [2.0.0 notes](https://github.com/synapseorch-ai/synapse-ai/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for what changes.
